name: SAPHO Syndrome
definition: Rare inflammatory syndrome combining osteitis/hyperostosis with acne or pustular skin disease, often involving the anterior chest wall, spine or sacroiliac joints.

investigations.principle: Imaging may show osteitis/hyperostosis; labs and biopsy/culture are used when infection or tumor cannot be excluded.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Exercise after active inflammation is controlled
amber: Diagnosis requires careful exclusion of infection and malignancy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-Shotha/Rakta phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Rare inflammatory syndrome combining osteitis/hyperostosis with acne or pustular skin disease, often involving the anterior chest wall, spine or sacroiliac joints.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
